receipt.scope: Three persistent checkpoint workers, two related real-scene proposal sets. Separate preparation, one warmup/three alternating measured rounds per mode. Five boxes: graphics off/on; six boxes including a repeated target: off. Same retained RGB-D/model/neural threads/batch/gates. Only depth-task concurrency changes. Nested timings overlap. Acquisition, caller decoding and GUI excluded; one shared workstation, not capacity qualification.
